# GlowQR
GlowQR is an AI-powered QR platform helping local businesses across India collect genuine Google reviews.
When customers scan a business's GlowQR code, they get AI-generated review suggestions based on their experience.
Customers can edit the suggestions and post in their own words.
GlowQR follows Google's policies: no review gating, filtering, or blocking of negative reviews.

# Pricing
- Free Trial: 3 days, free to start
- Premium: Rs 399/month
